title: Retro video game ports are surging with AI tools
body_html:
Classic video games are appearing on unusual platforms with increasing frequency. Recent viral projects include versions of games running in web browsers, on mobile phones, and within mixed reality environments.

According to reports, the surge in these unexpected ports over the past month is largely driven by the adoption of new artificial intelligence tools. These technologies are influencing how older software is handled and adapted for modern hardware and alternative interfaces.
